repositories.name: pdfium-xcframework
repositories.notes: CLASSIFICATION CONFLICT. The initial inventory lists pdfium-xcframework as BSD-style alongside pdfium. The licence actually present is MIT; see LICENSE for the original copyright notice. The clone contains only build scripts (build.sh, generate-package-files.sh) and docs, no pdfium source and no vendored BSD notice. Recorded as both; commercialUseOk unverified pending human review. The repo is a packaging harness; the artefact it would produce carries pdfium BSD-3-Clause. Nothing in the build invokes it or consumes the framework it produces.

The same file carries an EXTERNAL LICENSES section covering bsdiff/bspatch 4.3 (BSD-2-Clause), sais-lite (MIT) and a portable Ed25519 implementation. All would have to be reproduced in the About panel if it ever returned.

repositories.name: libxlsxwriter
repositories.notes: Self-described FreeBSD licence, which is BSD-2-Clause, in License.txt. Bundles queue.h (FreeBSD; The Regents of the University of California; BSD-3-Clause), tree.h (FreeBSD; Niels Provos; BSD-2-Clause), minizip (Zlib; altered source versions), md5 (public-domain dedication with a permissive fallback grant) and emyg_dtoa (MIT). licenseSpdx describes what is vendored and shipped; cloneLicenseSpdx describes the whole clone. CORRECTION 2026-08-23: the bundled tmpfileplus (DI Management Services) is MPL-2.0, not BSD as the initial inventory and the first pass of this file stated. It has no standalone licence file; the MPL header sits in third_party/tmpfileplus/tmpfileplus.c (sha256 bad61b21f48ef26fa82ad95cd01431334774ed528342d9a559de014f14ad7eb7) and tmpfileplus.h (sha256 eb4bc0ebc4332b6be6f5a0d42451c685047b5de9f3aba68dc3d63f8a5d19af8d). MPL-2.0 is file-level weak copyleft: MPL section 3.3 permits distribution inside a larger MIT work, while section 3.2 obliges us to make the source of those files available to recipients. Building with USE_STANDARD_TMPFILE excludes the component and removes the obligation; that build-flag decision was later taken: the bridge builds with USE_STANDARD_TMPFILE and vendors no tmpfileplus file (Bridges/LibXlsxWriterBridge/VENDORED.md).
